1966:  ****************************************************************************/

1968: static void rk3576_vicap_worker(FAR void *arg)
1969: {

1983:   int idx;
1984:   irqstate_t flags;

1986:   /* Say what the interface has reported since the last frame, if anything.
1987:    * Done here rather than in the interrupt so that the printing -- which goes
1988:    * to a console that may block -- stays off the interrupt path.
1989:    */

1991:   rk3576_vicap_report_errors(priv);
1992: 
1993:   /* Claim this frame together with the buffer the framework has offered for
1994:    * it.
1995:    *
1996:    * SET_BUF is the framework's way of saying "here is a buffer, fill it".
1997:    * It arrives once before the stream starts and again after every frame the
1998:    * framework accepts, so taking the buffer here both pairs the frame with
1999:    * the buffer meant for it and throttles the driver to the rate the
2000:    * framework can absorb.  Delivering a frame nobody asked for is not
2001:    * harmless: the completion path dereferences the framework's "next buffer"
2002:    * pointer without checking it, and that pointer is NULL once the queued
2003:    * buffers have all been consumed.
2004:    *
2005:    * The buffer is consumed in the same critical section, so a frame arriving
2006:    * before the framework offers a new one is dropped by the check below.
2007:    */
2008: 
2009:   flags = spin_lock_irqsave(&priv->irqlock);
2010:   idx = priv->raw_pending;
2011:   priv->raw_pending = -1;
2012:   priv->frame_scheduled = false;
2013:   dst = priv->dst;
2014:   dstsize = priv->dstsize;
2015:   priv->dst = NULL;
2016:   priv->dstsize = 0;
2017:   epoch = priv->stream_epoch;
2018:   spin_unlock_irqrestore(&priv->irqlock, flags);
2019: 
2020:   if (idx < 0)
2021:     {
2022:       return;
2023:     }
2024: 
2025:   if (dst == NULL)
2026:     {
2027:       /* Nothing was offered, so there is nowhere to put this frame.  This is
2028:        * ordinary back-pressure, not an error: the framework is simply not
2029:        * ready for another frame yet.  Counted apart from an overrun because
2030:        * the two mean the opposite thing -- this one says the application is
2031:        * behind, an overrun says this driver is.
2032:        */
2033: 
2034:       priv->dropcount++;
2035:       priv->drop_nobuf++;
2036:       return;
2037:     }
2038: 
2039:   /* Read the frame where it lies, when the timing allows it.
2040:    *
2041:    * VICAP writes DDR directly (its MMU is in pass-through), so the CPU's
2042:    * view of the RAW buffer has to be invalidated before reading it either
2043:    * way.
2044:    *
2045:    * The ping-pong that gives this driver one frame at a time is also what
2046:    * makes reading in place possible: with two buffers alternating, the one
2047:    * just finished is not written again until the other frame has been
2048:    * captured, so it is stable for exactly one frame interval.  Whether the
2049:    * demosaic fits in that interval is a property of the mode and the frame
2050:    * rate rather than of this code, so it is decided from what the last frame
2051:    * actually cost, and never assumed.  Getting it wrong is not a slow frame
2052:    * but a wrong one -- the DMA would overwrite the bottom of the buffer
2053:    * while the top was being read -- which is why the earlier version of this
2054:    * driver copied unconditionally.
2055:    *
2056:    * It is worth getting right, because the copy is not cheap here.  It costs
2057:    * as much traffic again as the demosaic itself, the frame being read,
2058:    * written and then read back, and this loop spends most of its time

2060:    */

2084:

2090:     }
2091:   else
2092:     {
2093:       struct timeval tc0;
2094:       struct timeval tc1;
2095: 
2096:       /* Timed because the copy is what has to outrun the DMA: it is safe
2097:        * only while it stays a small fraction of a frame interval, and that
2098:        * is worth being able to check rather than assume.
2099:        */
2100: 
2101:       gettimeofday(&tc0, NULL);
2102:       memcpy(priv->snap, priv->raw[idx], priv->rawlen);
2103:       gettimeofday(&tc1, NULL);
2104: 
2105:       priv->copy_us += (uint32_t)((tc1.tv_sec - tc0.tv_sec) * 1000000 +

2107:

2110:        * of the copy's exposure and the check belongs right here.
2111:        */
2112: 
2113:       if (priv->isr_frames != frames_before)

2115:           priv->racecount++;
2116:         }
2117: 
2118:       src = (FAR const uint16_t *)priv->snap;
2119:     }
2120: 
2121:   /* Timed separately from the frame as a whole, because this is the number
2122:    * the choice above is made from and it has to be the demosaic alone --
2123:    * counting the copy in with it would set the threshold by the thing being
2124:    * avoided.
2125:    */

2128:   rk3576_vicap_debayer(priv, src, dst);
2129:   gettimeofday(&td1, NULL);
2130: 
2131:   priv->debayer_us = (uint32_t)((td1.tv_sec - td0.tv_sec) * 1000000 +
2132:                                 (td1.tv_usec - td0.tv_usec));
2133:   priv->debayer_us_sum += priv->debayer_us;
2134:   priv->inplace_samples++;
2135: 
2136:   /* Reading where the frame lies is exposed for as long as the read takes,
2137:    * which is the whole of the demosaic, so the boundary is checked after it
2138:    * rather than around it.  The margin above is what is meant to keep this
2139:    * from ever firing; this is what says whether it did.
2140:    *
2141:    * A boundary inside the window means the DMA has begun overwriting the
2142:    * buffer that was being read, which is the one way this path can fail.  It
2143:    * is also the only thing that settles the question -- a prediction from
2144:    * timings can be unlucky, an observed boundary cannot -- so it ends the

2151:       priv->inplace_us_sum += priv->debayer_us;

2153:       if (priv->isr_frames != frames_before)

2155:           priv->racecount++;
2156:           priv->inplace_ok = false;
2157:         }
2158:     }
2159:   else
2160:     {
2161:       priv->copy_frames++;
2162:       priv->copy_demosaic_us_sum += priv->debayer_us;
2163:     }
2164: 
2165:   up_clean_dcache((uintptr_t)dst, (uintptr_t)dst + dstsize);
2166: 
2167:   gettimeofday(&t1, NULL);
2168:   priv->frame_us += (uint32_t)((t1.tv_sec - t0.tv_sec) * 1000000 +
2169:                                (t1.tv_usec - t0.tv_usec));

2174:    * while this frame was being demosaiced: the framework stops the stream

## 结论

审查意见成立,而且给出的路径分析与我读到的代码一致。`rk3576_vicap_stop_capture()` 只做"关状态 + 关中断",既不等待正在运行的 LPWORK worker,也没有任何别的同步机制;而 worker 在 latch 了 `src`/`dst` 之后要跑完整个去马赛克才检查 `stream_epoch`。释放/替换缓冲的一方(reconfigure、framework 关闭路径)与仍在读旧帧的 worker 之间确实没有握手。

我没有改动任何代码。以下是我逐层核到的证据。

## 一、worker 的窗口:局部变量跨越整个去马赛克

[rk3576_vicap.c:2009-2018](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2009-L2018) 在 `irqlock` 下一次性取走 `idx`、`dst`、`dstsize`、`epoch` 并清空 `priv->dst`;随后:

- [:2062-2063](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2062-L2063) 和 [:2089](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2089) 读 `priv->raw[idx]`,
- [:2102](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2102) 把 `priv->raw[idx]` 拷进 `priv->snap`,[:2118](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2118) 把 `snap` 作为 `src`,
- [:2128](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2128) 去马赛克写 `dst`,[:2165](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2165) 清 cache,
- 直到 [:2181-2189](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2181-L2189) 才在锁下检查 `!priv->capturing || callback == NULL || stream_epoch != epoch`,然后 [:2197](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2197) 回调。

所以审查者那句"worker 已将 src/dst 保存为局部变量,并在去马赛克完成后才检查 stream_epoch"完全准确。窗口里没有任何阻塞点(`report_errors()` 的打印在 [:1991](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L1991),在 latch 之前;去马赛克本身不打印、不休眠),只有一个 spinlock,而 spinlock 不能排除另一个 CPU/另一个线程。

顺带一点:[:2171-2179](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2171-L2179) 的注释说 epoch 检查"keeps that from happening",它防的是**把过期帧交给 framework**,并不覆盖缓冲访问——这条注释比它读起来要窄,修的时候应一并更正。

## 二、释放侧:三条路径都没有等 worker

1. **`stop_capture`**([:3057-3096](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3057-L3096)):清 `capturing`/`callback`/`dst`、`stream_epoch++`([:3077-3085](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3077-L3085)),然后 `input_disable` + `up_disable_irq`([:3092-3093](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3092-L3093))。`input_disable` 就是三句寄存器写([:898-911](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L898-L911)),没有读回等待。它也确实**不能**睡:framework 的 `complete_capture` 在 `spin_lock_irqsave_nopreempt` 下调用它([v4l2_cap.c:2012](nuttx/drivers/video/v4l2_cap.c#L2012)、[:2061](nuttx/drivers/video/v4l2_cap.c#L2061)、[:2079](nuttx/drivers/video/v4l2_cap.c#L2079)),而且这条路径自身可能就跑在 worker 线程里。审查者"不能在框架自旋锁的 stop_capture 中直接等待"的判断是对的。

2. **`reconfigure`**([:3668](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3668)):门槛只是 `priv->capturing`([:3722-3727](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3722-L3727)),而 `capturing` 在 stop_capture 里**立刻**变 false——worker 却可能还在跑。随后先把旧指针存下来([:3749-3755](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3749-L3755)),分配新缓冲([:3757](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3757)),然后 `rk3576_dma_free(oldraw[i])` / `kmm_free(oldsnap)`([:3772-3783](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3772-L3783))。它持有 `priv->lock`,但 worker 从头到尾**不取** `priv->lock`,两者没有任何互斥。

3. **`uninitialize`**([:3586-3662](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3586-L3662))是同一形状(只 detach IRQ 再 free,[:3612-3625](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3612-L3625))。目前它只在注册失败的 bring-up 路径被调到([kickpi_k7_camera.c:463](contest2026_062_PharosTech/boards/rk3576/kickpi-k7/src/kickpi_k7_camera.c#L463)),没有活 worker,算潜在同类项。

4. **"归还输出缓冲"这半,审查者也没说错**,而且它比 reconfigure 更早发生:worker 的 `dst` 就是 framework 的 captu/re 堆,而那个堆正是本驱动 `.alloc` 出来的 DMA 堆([:656-673](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L656-L673)),应用 `mmap` 进去。应用在 `VIDIOC_STREAMOFF` 之后马上 `munmap`、`close`([camenc_main.c:3655](contest2026_062_PharosTech/app/camenc/camenc_main.c#L3655)、[:3700](contest2026_062_PharosTech/app/camenc/camenc_main.c#L3700)),framework 的关闭路径再经 `cleanup_resources` → `cleanup_streamresources` → `imgdata->ops->free`([v4l2_cap.c:1214-1232](nuttx/drivers/video/v4l2_cap.c#L1214-L1232)、[:3652-3666](nuttx/drivers/video/v4l2_cap.c#L3652-L3666))把这个堆交回 DMA 堆。整条链上没有任何一处等 worker;`complete_capture` 里那条 epoch 检查也拦不住**已经发生**的写。

## 三、比审查者写的更严重的一点

`reconfigure` 最后才发布 `priv->cfg = *config`([:3791](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3791)),而 `buffers_alloc` 已经把 `priv->raw[] / snap / rawlen / stride` 换成新值([:3389-3398](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3389-L3398))。worker 的去马赛克**每帧现读** `priv->cfg.width/height/bayer`、`priv->stride`、`priv->wb[]`,而 `dstsize` 只用于 [:2165](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2165) 的 cache 清理,**不给去马赛克做边界**。于是同一个窗口除了 UAF,还能出现"latch 到的旧 `dst` + 新的宽高/stride":新几何更大时是**越界写**(平面偏移超出旧缓冲),不只是读到释放内存。这部分值得在意见里补上。

## 四、这份固件上的可达性(诚实评估)

审查者说"源码并发路径分析,未板测复现",这个定位是合适的。我核了调度配置,把可达性说清楚:

- 单核:`CONFIG_SMP` 未开,`CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS 1`;所以"SMP 上必然真并发"的论证在这个固件上不成立。
- 同优先级唤醒**不抢占**:`nxsched_add_readytorun` 只在严格更高优先级时切换([sched_addreadytorun.c:247-271](nuttx/sched/sched/sched_addreadytorun.c#L247-L271),非 SMP 分支;`nxsem_post` 走这条路,[sem_post.c:233](nuttx/sched/semaphore/sem_post.c#L233))。所以最常见的那条"worker 回调唤醒 camenc"不会中途把 worker 抢掉。
- 但 LPWORK 优先级 100([config.h:237](cmake_out/contest2026_062_PharosTech_camera/include/nuttx/config.h#L237))与 camenc 的 100([config.h:795](cmake_out/contest2026_062_PharosTech_camera/include/nuttx/config.h#L795))**相等**,而 RR 时间片是 200 ms([config.h:199](cmake_out/contest2026_062_PharosTech_camera/include/nuttx/config.h#L199)、[sched_roundrobin.c:152-177](nuttx/sched/sched/sched_roundrobin.c#L152-L177))。只要 worker 连续占用到时间片耗尽、且 app 因别的事件(编码器、网络)已经就绪,RR 就会把 worker 从**窗口内任意一点**换出去;app 随后可以一路 STREAMOFF → munmap → close → boardctl → reconfigure([camenc_main.c:3727](contest2026_062_PharosTech/app/camenc/camenc_main.c#L3727) → [kickpi_k7_camera.c:596](contest2026_062_PharosTech/boards/rk3576/kickpi-k7/src/kickpi_k7_camera.c#L596))而不必阻塞,被挂起的 worker 要等 app 再次阻塞才恢复——恢复时缓冲可能已经归堆。
- 因此:在当前配置下窗口窄、依赖 RR 与"app 恰好就绪"的巧合,板测不易复现;但只要 app 优先级高于 LPWORK、或打开 SMP、或别处给 worker 加了阻塞/打印,窗口立刻变宽。这类"正确性依赖调度巧合"的缺陷按 P1 记是合理的。

## 五、修复方向的约束(仅记录,未动代码)

- 同步点只能放在**可阻塞**的路径:`reconfigure` / `uninitialize`(已经在 `nxmutex_lock` 上阻塞),不能放 `stop_capture`(框架自旋锁 + 抢占关闭,且可能由 worker 自身进入,会自等死锁)。这与审查者的建议一致。
- 本 NuttX 有 `work_cancel_sync()`,语义正是"取消;若正在执行则等它跑完"([wqueue.h:516-540](nuttx/include/nuttx/wqueue.h#L516-L540)),是这条路径可用的原语;注意 `frame_scheduled` 会在 worker 里清,ISR 也只用一个 work 结构([:2297-2308](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2297-L2308)),等待逻辑不能假设"至多一个实例"。
- `dst` 那半(**输出缓冲**)不在驱动自己的释放路径上:释放者是 framework 的 `cleanup_streamresources` 和应用的 `munmap`。要让它们排在 worker 之后,光改 `reconfigure` 不够,还需要 framework 关闭路径(或应用)与驱动有同一个"worker 已退出"的握手——这一点审查意见只说到"归还输出缓冲也有同类风险",没展开,实现时是最容易漏的一半。
- 另外 `priv->cfg/stride/rawlen` 的发布与 worker 的读取也需要一并纳入同一握手,否则即便缓冲不释放,几何错配仍会写越界。

要我接着做的话,可以:(a) 只写一份不改码的修复方案(同步点、原语、`dst` 半边的归属和顺序);(b) 等你决定后再动 `rk3576_vicap.c`。

`input_disable`([:3734](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3734),三个寄存器写)→ 存旧指针([:3749-3755](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3749-L3755))→ 分配新缓冲([:3757](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3757))→ `dma_free`/`kmm_free`([:3772-3783](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3772-L3783))→ 发布 `cfg`([:3791](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3791))。

这里有个容易看反的地方。NuttX 里"worker"有两种状态,而**能被杀掉的恰好是不危险的那个**:

- **还在队列里没开始跑的**:即使不取消,它稍后跑起来时 `priv->dst` 已被 stop_capture 清空,于是走 [:2025-2037](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2025-L2037) 早退,根本不碰 `raw/snap`。它"碰巧"安全。

## 第二个问题:"杀了重开"能解决吗——不能完整解决,而且位置不对

先把"杀"的三种含义分开,因为结论完全不同:

**(a) `work_cancel()` —— 没用。** 它是非阻塞的,只从队列里摘掉还没开始的项;对正在执行的工作,`work_available(work)` 已经为真,直接返回 `-ENOENT`,**不等待**([kwork_cancel.c:64-78](nuttx/sched/wqueue/kwork_cancel.c#L64-L78))。也就是说它恰好管不到危险的那个。

**(b) `work_cancel_sync()` —— 语义对,但放在 reconfigure 里太晚。** 它是 `do { work_qcancel(sync=true) } while (-EBUSY)`;发现该 work 正被**别的线程**执行就 `wait_count++` 并 `nxsem_wait` 到它结束([kwork_cancel.c:84-109](nuttx/sched/wqueue/kwork_cancel.c#L84-L109)、[:173-184](nuttx/sched/wqueue/kwork_cancel.c#L173-L184))。对"调用者就是 worker 自己"是安全的(`worker[wndx].pid != pid` 判断),不会自锁死 —— 但那时它也不等待。它能解决 `reconfigure` 自己那一半(`oldraw/oldsnap`)。

**(c) 强行中止正在执行的 worker / 杀 LPWORK 线程 —— 不存在也不该。** worker 是普通函数,没有取消点,只能靠它自己轮询标志;LPWORK 是全局共享的低优先级工作队列,别的驱动也在上面跑,不能杀。

**"重开"这个动作本身没有意义**:采集已经停了,`reconfigure` 之后没有要重开的东西;若在释放之后又 `work_queue` 一次,只会让 worker 拿着**新的 `raw`/`snap` + 旧的/新的 `cfg`** 再跑一遍,反而制造新的错配窗口。

**关键在顺序 —— 即使换成 `work_cancel_sync`,放在 reconfigure 也只修了一半:**

camenc 切换分辨率的真实路径是(逐跳可查):`switching=true; break` → `goto errout_camoff`([camenc_main.c:3556](contest2026_062_PharosTech/app/camenc/camenc_main.c#L3556))→ **STREAMOFF**([:3631](contest2026_062_PharosTech/app/camenc/camenc_main.c#L3631),进驱动 stop_capture)→ **munmap**([:3655](contest2026_062_PharosTech/app/camenc/camenc_main.c#L3655))→ **close(camfd)**([:3700](contest2026_062_PharosTech/app/camenc/camenc_main.c#L3700))→ framework `cleanup_resources`/`cleanup_streamresources`([v4l2_cap.c:1214-1232](nuttx/drivers/video/v4l2_cap.c#L1214-L1232))→ `ops->free` → `rk3576_dma_free(frame heap)`([rk3576_vicap.c:656-673](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L656-L673))→ **然后才** boardctl([camenc_main.c:3727](contest2026_062_PharosTech/app/camenc/camenc_main.c#L3727))→ lane rate → **reconfigure**。

worker 的 `dst` 就落在这个 frame heap 里,它在 **close(camfd) 那一刻**就已经归还 DMA 堆了 —— 比 reconfigure 早了 munmap + close + boardctl + PHY 切换这一段。所以"在 reconfigure 里等 worker"能保护 `raw/snap`,但 `dst` 的 UAF 写在此之前已经发生。

有一个对我们有利的事实:`CONFIG_BUILD_FLAT=1`([config.h:16](cmake_out/contest2026_062_PharosTech_camera/include/nuttx/config.h#L16)),应用的 `munmap` 只是解除映射登记,那块内存本来就是驱动交给框架的 frame heap,**应用无权释放它**,真正归还只发生在 `ops->free → rk3576_dma_free`。而 `.free` 的上下文是可阻塞的(应用线程走 close/REQBUFS,不在 `complete_capture` 的自旋锁里,也没有从 worker 调用)。所以 `dst` 这一半是可以在驱动内部堵住的 —— 等待点应该放在 `.free` 里、`rk3576_dma_free` 之前。

The user is proposing a specific design: a "stop flag" / quiesce handshake between the reconfigure path and the worker — reconfigure raises a stop signal, worker notices it each frame (at frame boundaries or mid-frame), finishes the current frame, acknowledges, reconfigure proceeds to reconfigure, then clears the flag and lets the worker resume (unblock).

They ask: "是吗" — is that what I expect?

I should answer honestly: not exactly. That design (a flag polled by the worker + acknowledgement) is one valid implementation, and it's essentially what work_cancel_sync gives you for free. But there are important corrections:

1. The handshake only works if the worker actually polls — and the worker function is one frame per invocation. There's no long-lived "worker thread" of ours; it's the shared LPWORK thread running our function once per frame. So "让 worker 线程每帧检查" is really "in the worker function, check the flag" — which is exactly the `capturing`/`epoch` check that already exists, except it must happen *before* touching buffers and/or an acknowledgement must be published *after* the last buffer touch.

2. Critical: a "stop and resume" handshake is the wrong shape for this driver. There's nothing to resume. `stop_capture` has already happened (that's why reconfigure is allowed to run); `reconfigure` finishes while the stream is still off; the worker is not "unblocked to continue" — the next stream is started later by a fresh `start_capture` (from STREAMON), which resets `frame_scheduled`/`raw_pending`. So "配置完成之后再取消 worker 线程的阻塞" is unnecessary; there is no per-stream worker thread to unblock. If you did keep a flag that parks the worker, you'd have to make sure the *next* stream clears it, and you'd add a state that can get stuck (e.g., the error path in reconfigure that returns without publishing).

Actually, careful: there is a scenario where the app stops and restarts without reconfigure — but even then, the worker is queued fresh by the ISR each frame; there's no blocking park.

3. The wait must be a *wait*, not a "notify and hope". If reconfigure raises a flag and then immediately frees, the worker may be mid-frame → same UAF. You must not proceed until the worker has actually acknowledged (i.e., left the window). So the shape is: set flag (under irqlock) → wait for "worker idle" (semaphore/counter decremented) → free/replace → publish new cfg. The wait is blocking, which is why it can only live in reconfigure/`.free`/uninitialize.

4. Where the flag alone is insufficient: the worker can also be *queued but not started*. With `capturing == false`, the queued one exits early (safe), but if you use a counter you must make sure the "idle" condition counts queued-but-not-started work too — else you'd consider it idle (counter 0) while a queued invocation is about to run. Actually a queued-but-not-started worker returns early (dst==NULL), so it's harmless for the buffers; but it would still run *after* reconfigure and if a new stream had started in between... it latches a fresh epoch and drops. Hmm, but it could also steal the new stream's dst (I mentioned earlier). That's a separate, pre-existing issue, not something the handshake must solve. But it means "worker idle" (counter == 0) can be true while a work item is still queued → if you rely purely on the counter and not on `work_cancel_sync`, you might free in the presence of a queued worker. That queued one won't touch buffers with dst==NULL, so it's fine — unless a new dst was set. Since reconfigure only runs with the device closed (stream off), dst is NULL. OK. Still, `work_cancel_sync` is simpler and also removes the queued entry (keeping `frame_scheduled` consistent is the side note).

5. `work_cancel_sync()` already implements exactly this handshake — the flag, the wait, and it's installed in the kernel (it checks `worker[wndx].work == work && pid != caller`). Using it means you don't hand-roll a flag and a semaphore and you don't need the "resume" step. The one thing it doesn't cover is doing the wait from a context that can't sleep — which is why it goes in `reconfigure`/`.free`, not `stop_capture`.

6. The `dst` half is not covered by a flag the *driver* polls: the frame heap is released in the framework's close path from the app's `close()`; reconfigure runs later. So the flag/wait must also be at the driver's `.free` hook (before `rk3576_dma_free`). A single "reconfigure wait" does not close that.

7. Also: don't forget `uninitialize` (same shape) and the geometry fields (`cfg`/`stride`/`rawlen`) must be published *after* the wait.

8. One more subtlety: the worker checks `priv->capturing`/`epoch` at the *end*, and it's the last thing it does before returning. So an acknowledgement ("worker left") can be derived from the work-queue API rather than a driver flag. If hand-rolling: set a `quiesce` flag under irqlock; have the worker, at its very end (after removing itself from the "in flight" count), post a sem. The wait then covers the whole buffer window.

Also, "让 worker 线程每帧检查" — the worker already checks state at the top (via latch + dst==NULL early return) and at the end (epoch). Adding a check at the top would let a *new* invocation skip work, but the dangerous invocation has already passed that point; so a top-of-frame check does not protect the buffers on its own. The protection is the *wait*, not the check. That's the key misconception to correct: a cooperative stop flag alone is racy — it only helps if the setter waits for the acknowledgement before freeing.

So: their design is roughly right in spirit (quiesce handshake), but:
- the "check each frame" part is not what makes it safe; the "wait for the acknowledgement before freeing" part is;
- there's no "unblock the worker afterwards" step needed — the worker isn't parked, and the stream is started fresh by start_capture (which already resets frame_scheduled/raw_pending and bumps epoch);
- it must be installed at every release point (`.free` for the frame heap, reconfigure for raw/snap, uninitialize) and before publishing the new geometry;
- `work_cancel_sync()` is the ready-made version of exactly this handshake, with the added bonus that it also removes a queued (not yet started) entry, and it's self-call-safe;
- don't put any of it in stop_capture.

## 直接回答:不能这么说

**这次修复本身在 SMP 下是成立的**,而且它关掉的那个竞争在 SMP 下也关掉了。但"驱动在 SMP 下没有风险"是另一回事——还有三处,其中两处是既有的、和这次改动无关的 SMP 缺陷。

### 先说这次修复在 SMP 下的有效性(我核实过)

- `work_qcancel(sync)` 是遍历该 wqueue 的**全部** worker 线程来找"这条 work 正在被谁执行"的(`for (wndx = 0; wndx < wqueue->nthreads; wndx++)`,并且用 `worker[wndx].pid != pid` 排除调用者自己),所以 worker 跑在另一个 CPU 上也认得出来([kwork_cancel.c:84-109](nuttx/sched/wqueue/kwork_cancel.c#L84-L109))。
- 等待用的信号量是在 `CALL_WORKER()` 返回之后、同一把队列锁下 post 的([kwork_thread.c:255-271](nuttx/sched/wqueue/kwork_thread.c#L255-L271)),所以"等到"就等于"worker 函数整个跑完了"。
- 等待前会释放 wqueue 锁([kwork_cancel.c:104-108](nuttx/sched/wqueue/kwork_cancel.c#L104-L108)),不会持锁睡眠。
- 死锁面我查了:`priv->lock` 只在 initialize/start_capture/reconfigure/uninitialize/dump 里取([:2632](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2632)、[:3493](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3493)、[:3651](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3651)、[:3755](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3755)、[:3897](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L3897)),worker 的调用树(report_errors → debayer → wb_update → callback)**一处都不取**,所以 reconfigure/uninitialize 持 `priv->lock` 等 worker 不会反转。

**一个前提要记住**:这依赖 LPWORK 是全局单实例。`g_lpwork` 只有打开 `CONFIG_BMP` 才变成 per-CPU([percpu.h:111-121](nuttx/include/nuttx/percpu.h#L111-L121)、[kwork_thread.c:122-124](nuttx/sched/wqueue/kwork_thread.c#L122-L124)),本配置没开(`CONFIG_SCHED_LPNTHREADS=1`、无 `CONFIG_BMP`,[config.h:236](cmake_out/contest2026_062_PharosTech_camera/include/nuttx/config.h#L236))。**哪天真开 BMP,`work_cancel_sync(LPWORK, ...)` 会去查调用者所在 CPU 的那条队列,ISR 把 work 排到的是另一条,等待就静默失效。** 那时必须换成 `work_queue_create()` 出来的显式共享队列 + `work_queue_wq`/`work_cancel_sync_wq`。这是这次修复唯一"配置相关"的软肋,值得记到注释或备忘里。

## SMP 下仍需处理的三处

**(a) 框架回调那段交接——SMP 下仍然开着(本次没修)**

worker 通过检查([:2181-2193](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2181-L2193))之后到调 callback([:2197](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2197))之间被推迟时,另一个 CPU 上的 app 可以走完 `capture_close` → `cleanup_resources` → `cleanup_streamresources`:那里**先** `video_framebuff_uninit` 释放 container、`nxsem_destroy` 掉 dqbuf 信号量,然后才调 `.free`([v4l2_cap.c:1214-1219](nuttx/drivers/video/v4l2_cap.c#L1214-L1219)),我加的等待就在 `.free` 里,已经太晚。callback 会写已释放的 container、post 已销毁的信号量。

坦白说它的窗口要求 worker 在那两三行内被推迟几十微秒(比如被更高优先级任务抢走),不是"必然并发";但要封住它,等待必须提到框架拆自身状态**之前**,也就是动 `v4l2_cap.c` 的阻塞路径,或给 imgdata ops 加一个 quiesce 钩子。

**(b) ISR 不取 `irqlock`——SMP 下是实打实的竞争**

ISR([:2268](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2268))直接读写 `raw_pending`、`frame_scheduled`、`isr_frames`、`isr_ticks`、`interval_ticks`、`errstat`、`fs_count`/`fe_count`、`dropcount`/`drop_overrun`([:2354](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2354)、[:2358](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2358)、[:2384](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2384)、[:2394](contest2026_062_PharosTech/chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c#L2394)),完全不碰锁,靠的是"本 CPU 关中断"。单核成立;SMP 下 worker 在另一个 CPU 的 `irqlock` 临界区里读 `raw_pending`/清 `frame_scheduled`,ISR 不认这把锁 → 丢帧、重复调度、计数与 `errstat` 位丢失。这个不需要任何巧合,只要 ISR 和 worker 落在不同 CPU 就会发生。修法:ISR 的状态更新段也取 `irqlock`(锁序 `irqlock → wqueue->lock`,ISR 里 `work_queue` 拿的是后者,没有反向路径)。

**(c) `up_disable_irq` 不是"ISR 已结束"的屏障**

stop/reconfigure 之后,另一个 CPU 上正在执行的 ISR 仍会跑完并写状态。这和 (b) 是同一类,靠 (b) 的锁解决;`up_disable_irq` 本身只保证不再投递。

另外一个小项:`rk3576_vicap_dump`(close 时经 `.uninit` 调用)会读 `priv->raw[0]` 并做 dcache 操作,它现在排在 `.free` 的等待之后是**隐含顺序**,注释里没写。

stopped stream is safe by then -- the epoch check sees to that -- so what
was left open is the buffers.

already running is waited for.  It sleeps, so it can only live where the
caller may block, which is why it is not in stop_capture(): the framework
also reaches that from the completion callback, with a spinlock held and
preemption disabled.  In reconfigure the wait goes with the input already

## 提交

**`09695f1` — `cam: wait for the frame worker before its buffers go`**
分支 `supercat-camera`,作者 `yunline <yunline@foxmail.com>`,1 个文件 `chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c`,+131/−6,提交后 `git status` 与 `git diff HEAD` 均为空。

提交信息按仓库既有风格写(短前缀 + 散文式正文,无 footer),分四段说明:

1. **问题**:worker 在帧开头 latch 读的 RAW 和写的 framework 缓冲并保持整个去马赛克过程,末尾的 epoch 检查排在所有读写**之后**,所以它保不住缓冲生命周期——之前被当成覆盖了整个暴露面。
2. **三条释放路径都没等**:framework 的 close/REQBUFS 释放 frame heap(worker 的目标缓冲所在)、`reconfigure` 释放 RAW/拷贝并换几何、驱动自身 take-down。
3. **修法**:三处都用 `work_cancel_sync()`;因为要睡,所以只能放可阻塞路径,不能放 `stop_capture()`(框架从 completion callback 持自旋锁、禁抢占调用);`reconfigure` 的等待放在 input 关闭之后、碰第一个缓冲之前。
4. **为多核顺带修的两处**:ISR 现在取 worker 的锁(且在读 W1C 的 INTSTAT 之前),`capturing` 为假时不派 worker;并说明 `up_disable_irq` 只停投递、不停已在别处执行的 ISR。最后一段声明单核行为不变,便于将来归因。

## 仍开着的两项(已按你的决定留在代码外,未写进提交)

- **(a) 框架侧交接**:worker 通过 epoch 检查到调 callback 之间被推迟时,app 可能已在另一 CPU 上拆掉 framework 的 container/信号量。要封得改 [nuttx/drivers/video/v4l2_cap.c](nuttx/drivers/video/v4l2_cap.c)(交付仓库之外),或给 imgdata ops 加 quiesce 钩子。
- **SMP 的两个近似**:worker 里 `isr_frames`/`interval_ticks` 的无锁读(ARM64 上对齐 32 位读不撕裂,属启发式判据);以及 `CONFIG_BMP` 若开启时 `g_lpwork` 变 per-CPU、`work_cancel_sync(LPWORK, ...)` 会查错队列,那时要换显式共享队列。
